leads.title: Song of the strong city; your dead shall live ↔ The folding up: twelve signs of the end and the messenger on the horizon
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: Victim's blood cries out from the ground to God (weight 6.3). Pair score 6.3.

Only in Song of the strong city; your dead shall live: Other lords ruled us; they are dead, they will not live; shades (rephaim) will not rise; their memory is wiped out; God's dew is a 'dew of lights' (tal orot) and the earth will give birth to the shades (rephaim); The earth will disclose the blood shed on it and no longer cover its slain; 'Go, my people, enter your chambers and shut the doors behind you; hide a little moment until the wrath passes'; We were pregnant, we writhed, but gave birth only to wind; we brought no salvation to the earth; God keeps the steadfast mind in perfect peace (shalom shalom) because it trusts in him; 'My soul yearns for you in the night; my spirit within me seeks you at dawn'; 'We have a strong city... Open the gates that the righteous nation that keeps faith may enter'; In Yah YHWH is an everlasting rock (tsur olamim); What the dead say when they wake from the dust [divergence between the texts]; On God's day all that is lofty (cedars of Lebanon, oaks of Bashan, towers, ships of Tarshish) is brought low and God alone exalted; The Gardens of Eden have their gates opened for the righteous; and 7 more.

Only in The folding up: twelve signs of the end and the messenger on the horizon: The revelation is the word of a noble messenger, powerful, secure with the Lord of the Throne, obeyed and trustworthy; Oath by the stars (or planets) that withdraw, run their course and hide (al-khunnas, al-jawari al-kunnas); At the end the ten-month pregnant she-camels ('ishar) are left untended; Opponents call the prophet mad (majnun) or possessed; scripture denies it; The prophet saw the heavenly messenger on the clear horizon; At the end the souls are paired (with bodies or their like); At the end the wild beasts are gathered together; At the judgment the girl buried alive (al-maw'uda) is asked for what sin she was killed; All the host of heaven rot away and the heavens roll up like a scroll; their host falls like withered leaves from vine and fig [divergence between the texts]; You will not will unless God wills; Then each soul will know what it has brought forward and what it left behind; At the end the seas are set aflame or burst forth (sujjirat, fujjirat); and 7 more.

matches.note: Sky and scroll: Isa 34:4 we-nāgōllû kas-sēfer ha-ššāmāyim (the heavens are rolled up LIKE a scroll). Q 81:10-11 wa-idhā ṣ-ṣuḥufu nushirat wa-idhā s-samāʾu kushiṭat: the scrolls (of deeds) are spread open and the sky is stripped off. The image is split: the sky is removed, the scroll is opened rather than rolled.
